title: Kernel autotuner and pinned profile lifecycle for MoE / GQA / MHA models
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a repeatable pipeline and runtime hooks for producing, pinning, and publishing model-specific compilation artifacts (kernel binaries / tuning profiles) for three complex architecture classes: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), and Multi-Head Attention (MHA). The pipeline must produce deterministic, signed profile bundles that can be pinned to model versions in the model catalog, allow safe canary/fallback behavior, and include heuristics/runtime checks for GPU fragmentation, memory layout, and quantization mode.
acceptance_criteria: Autotuner daemon produces a signed profile bundle for each new model onboarding job (MHA/GQA/MoE) with metadata and semver tag
Model catalog supports a pinned kernel_profile field on model versions and a fallback chain to compatible profiles
Runtime selects pinned profile by default and can automatically fall back to compatible generic profiles with telemetry when pinned profile fails
Profiles include compatibility matrix entries: supported CUDA runtime, cutlass/cuda kernel variant, quantization mode, and estimated throughput/latency numbers
Canary rollout flow: ability to route X% of traffic to a new pinned profile and auto-rollback on SLO regressions
Conformance tests validate numerical stability for top-3 prompts in onboarding prompt set across all kernel variants
Artifact signing + immutability window: published bundles cannot be overwritten; superseded by a new semver release
Documentation and SDK helpers for pinning/unpinning profiles in the console and API
steps: Design manifest v2 for profile bundles (metadata, semver, signed checksum, compatibility matrix)
Implement autotuner worker that runs microbenchmarks across candidate kernels for the three architectures
Extend model catalog API to accept kernel_profile pins and a fallback chain
Runtime: implement profile loader with strict validation and fast failure paths to fallback chain
Add canary routing support in serving gateway and build SLO checks to trigger rollback
Create conformance harness that runs numeric tests vs golden outputs and records deltas in evals
Doc and SDK: expose pin/unpin endpoints and a console page to inspect profile metrics
decisions: Use a separate autotuner service instead of embedding tuner in the buildfarm to reduce blast radius
Bundle format will be JSON+protobuf metadata plus signed tarball of compiled kernels and perf traces
Semver scheme: <major>.<minor>.<patch>-profile.<hash> where major increments for ABI-breaking kernel changes
Default runtime behavior: prefer pinned profile -> semver-compatible profile -> generic fallback. No automatic silent rollback unless SLO threshold violated
Do not attempt to canonicalize MoE routing codegen in this ticket; focus on kernel selection and memory layout tuning for MoE to minimize fragmentation
tradeoffs: Autotuner runtime-complete tuning increases onboarding latency by ~6-12 hours for large MoE models; we accept longer onboarding in exchange for stable production performance
Storing multiple compiled variants increases registry storage cost; mitigated by retention policy and LRU eviction for older patches
Signed immutable bundles add operational complexity for emergency fixes; we will support an emergency 'hotfix' path with audit logging
Heavier conformance testing reduces false positives but increases CI time; we will gate heavy numeric checks to nightly runs and lightweight checks to pre-release canaries
comments: 2026-03-02 | Aisha Patel: Kicked off design doc. Initial scope: tuning heuristics for MoE expert shard placement, GQA block size sweep, and fused MHA QKV kernels. Asked infra to reserve 8x A100 nodes for autotuner runs.

2026-03-04 | Jonas Meyer: Prototype autotuner can run cutlass and cuBLAS variants and emit perf traces. Observed 18% variance in MoE peak throughput across different expert shard layouts on 40GB GPUs.
2026-03-06 | Keiko Tanaka (PM): Please add console UX for pin rollback and explain canary criteria. Customer success flagged enterprise customer that requires immutable profile audit logs.
2026-03-08 | Security (Ethan Ruiz): Reviewed bundle signing approach. Need HSM integration for production signing; defer to separate ticket but include signature envelope now.

2026-03-10 | Jonas Meyer: Implemented manifest v2 parser and local smoke tests. Found failure mode: pinned profile compiled against CUTLASS v3.2 fails on older driver on dedicated nodes. Plan: include minimum driver required field and a runtime compatibility check.

2026-03-12 | Design review (Maya Singh): UX feedback: show estimated delta in latency/cost for each profile in console and warn when pin will increase memory usage. Approved canary UX with percentage slider and preflight checks.
notes: Prototype results: For a 30B MoE model, tuned memory layout (expert buffer sharding + interleaved KV) improved steady-state tokens/sec by 22% compared to baseline generic kernels
GQA heuristics: prefer block-sizes that align with warp size when query groups > 8 to unlock warp-level matrix multiply optimizations
MHA optimization: fused QKV with fused rotary multiplication gave consistent latency wins for sequence lengths <= 1024, but higher memory pressure at 2048+
Operational runbook: if pinned profile fails validation on startup, route traffic to next fallback and create an automated rollback PR that marks the profile as 'quarantined' in catalog
